title: A little hare-raising afternoon

commercials.copy: A little pause. A little popcorn.

editorial_notes: Nine selected shots preserve the original park, train, chase, family, and rabbit ending.
The quiet living-room shot plays at half speed. Only the clean first five seconds of the braking source are used.
Children jumping and the rabbit side-eye use separate reaction shots.
Each shot is conformed to its exact 24 fps duration; commercial end frames are held to six seconds.
Commercial typography is added in the edit using Avenir Next. The right third stays quiet for live notes.
